execution: Unity Editor Texture2D pixel operations and TextureImporter; invoke with official Unity MCP
coordinateSystem: Source/destination rectangles: native pixels, top-left x,y,width,height. Authoring coordinates: 1440x607; converted independently using each original width/height.
alphaPolicy: Manual source-space masks preserve approved art; no generative edits. Occluded portrait badges are cut transparent and replaced by runtime labels.
limitations: Original screenshots are flattened. The shared v10 transparent window_frame is reused for main_frame because the Jubaozhai window outline is occluded by scenery, tabs and close button. Avatar pixels originally occluded by badges cannot be recovered; badge regions are transparent. The static Chinese title is retained intentionally.
importer: Sprite Single, 100 PPU, FullRect, explicit border, Clamp, Bilinear, no mipmap, no compression, RGBA32, sRGB

sprites.name: main_frame
sprites.processing: Exact reuse of certified text-free v10 window_frame; original source qdao_ui_style_recut_v10/source/02-main-window.png. Existing transparent ornament alpha and four slice borders retained.
